description: OpenAI-compatible text-to-speech — Drop-in OpenAI Audio Speech API: POST {input (max 1500 chars), language (en, es, fr, zh, ja, ko; default en)} and get the spoken audio back as an MP3 body, like client.audio.speech.create. model, voice, speed and response_format are accepted for compatibility but ignored (one natural voice per language, MeloTTS).
